entities.summary: Anthony William Fairbank Edwards, FRS is a British statistician, geneticist and evolutionary biologist. Edwards is regarded as one of Britain's most distinguished geneticists, and as one of the most influential mathematical geneticists in history. He is the son of the surgeon Harold C. Edwards, and brother of medical geneticist John H. Edwards. Edwards has sometimes been called "Fisher's Edwards" to distinguish him from his brother, because he was mentored by Ronald Fisher. In 1963 and 1964, Edwards, along with Luigi Luca Cavalli-Sforza, introduced novel methods for computing evolutionary trees from genetical data.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Edwards' work on evolutionary trees from genetical data significantly advanced our understanding of human population dynamics and genetic variation. His methods have had lasting impacts on fields such as genetics, epidemiology, and conservation biology.
